verdict.rationale: Zero is an email client with an official MCP server, so a sandbox or test mode for agents is a fair question to ask. The evidence shows no such capability. The items present are adjacent rather than a product sandbox: contributor dev tooling (local database and dev servers via `pnpm go`, devcontainer, Drizzle Studio), internal AI test and eval scripts, and self-hosting. The documented MCP connection authenticates against a real session and acts on live mailboxes connected through Gmail OAuth.
